participation.context: Walked past the butts toward the rise.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You walked the fields with your head down. The archers, the linen, and the windmills were there, and you did not stop.

title: Passed the butts and kept walking

participation.context: Said the line three times and took it with him.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You repeated the opening until the breath had it. You did not stay at the butts, and you did not go on to a second speech.

title: Said Navarre's first line until it sat in the breath

participation.context: Wrote the phrases and shut the tables.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You set down the three phrases, left them untitled, and shut the tables.

title: Wrote three phrases and shut the tables

participation.context: Said the line once and did not add to it.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You said that a king who opens on Fame had better not have a hole in his hose. Then you stopped.

title: Said the line about Fame and the hole in the hose

participation.context: Wrote the two lines, named nobody, and stopped.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You wrote two lines, left them without a name, and did not read them out. Friday's leaf stayed in the folder, unchanged.

description: Ten of the clock, and forty

participation.context: Wrote the lodge hour and did not open the sealed paper onto the page.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You entered the lodge at ten-forty and left the Errors where Saturday had put them. You did not write the paper's contents.
topics: ten of the clock and forty

title: Set the lodge for ten of the clock and forty
